sections.label: The opening
sections.para: A plan: a piano PDF to MusicXML through recognition, checked by rendering back, imported into Sibelius and adjusted by plugin or Sibelius Connect; then handwriting, from the composer's own corrected pages; four MVPs.

sections.label: In short
sections.para: Two phases; MusicXML in the middle; the check; Sibelius last; handwriting from examples; four MVPs.

sections.label: What my friend wants
sections.para: A piano PDF read into Sibelius, then handwritten pages read onto the staff, from someone who has watched an agent catalogue their files.

sections.label: An open format in the middle
sections.line: An open format in the middle
sections.para: Recognise to MusicXML, which Sibelius imports: Audiveris (open source, MusicXML export), PhotoScore (commercial, sold for Sibelius), or the model reading the page.

sections.label: Check by rendering back
sections.para: Render the MusicXML as an image, compare with the page bar by bar, fix, and list what changed.

sections.label: Driving Sibelius
sections.para: For layout, house style and instruments: a ManuScript plugin, then Sibelius Connect from 2024.3, the screen last.

sections.label: The agent and its computer
sections.para: A scheduled Claude session, connected by Remote Control to the composer's computer with a policy for what it may touch, its work in a vault.

sections.label: Phase two: the composer's handwriting
sections.para: Not training a model but keeping examples: each corrected page becomes an example for the next, and accuracy can be watched rising.

sections.label: Four MVPs
sections.para: One printed page; the check loop; into Sibelius with the composer's settings; one handwritten page with its correction kept.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.para: A plan; accuracy untested; Sibelius Connect unread; rights to the music; the friend unnamed.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.para: The voice memo in Portuguese and English, with a translation, and search results on the tools.
